About Naga

Naga Industries is a Philippine laptop and AI mini PC brand. Three machines, one spirit: Sulong, always forward.

The lineup

LAKAN II
Gaming laptop. Intel Core 7 250H, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU at up to 115W, 16GB DDR5-5600, 512GB PCIe Gen4 SSD, 15.6-inch display. ₱89,900 (≈ US$1,430) with the Naga Karga backpack. Pre-order now.
SIPAG I
Productivity laptop. Intel Core Ultra 5 125U, 14-inch Full HD, 60Wh battery for up to 13 hours, 1.30 kg, USB-C charging. Pre-order now.
DIWA
AI mini PC. Runs Baku, Naga's own AI, on the machine. Coming soon, no price yet; reservations are open.

Baku

Baku is Naga's own AI. It ships on DIWA and runs on the machine itself, so your data stays private and it keeps working offline. It speaks every language. Baku is being built with the Machine.Fun ecosystem; follow the build. The name comes from the Bakunawa, the sea serpent of Philippine myth that rose to swallow the moon.

Warranty and orders

Every Naga laptop comes with a one-year local warranty. For warranty claims, service or to track an order, email hello@nagatech.ph with your order reference (it starts with NG-).
